--- CLI COMMANDS (3-Letter Codes) ---
 [MIXER]
  vol <0-100> : Master Volume
  mix <0-100> : Dry/Wet Mix
  byp <0/1>   : Bypass
  src <0-2>   : Source (0=MP3, 1=Synth, 2=I2S)
 [TAPE ENGINE]
  dly <ms>    : Delay Time (10-2000)
  fbk <0-100> : Feedback
  hds <1-7>   : Active Heads
  mus <0/1>   : Head Mode (0=Free, 1=Musical)
  mod <0/1>   : Engine Mode (0=Saturator, 1=Delay)
  tps <0-100> : Tape Speed (Varispeed)
  tpa <0-100> : Tape Age (Filter)
  drv <0-100> : Drive / Saturation
  nlv <0-100> : Noise Level
  ngt <0-100> : Gate Threshold
  red <0-100> : Gate Reduction % (0=None, 100=Mute)
  hbp <0-100> : Head Bump
  azm <0-100> : Azimuth (50=Center)
 [COLOR]
  gfc <0/1>   : Guitar Focus (BPF)
  ton <0-100> : Tone Control
 [MODULATION]
  dps <0-100> : Dropouts
  ftd <0-100> : Flutter Depth % (maps to 0-45 core range)
  ftr <0.1-20>: Flutter Rate in Hz
  wwd <0-100> : Wow Depth % (maps to 0-35 core range)
  wwr <0.1-5> : Wow Rate in Hz
 [MELODY GEN]
  wvf <0-3>   : Waveform (Sine, Saw, Tri, Sqr)
  scl <0-4>   : Scale
  ptc <midi>  : Root Key
  moo <0-100> : Mood
  rtm <0-100> : Rhythm Density
 [EFFECT MODES]
  frz <0/1>   : Freeze/Hold
  rev <0/1>   : Reverse Delay
  revmode <0..2> : Rhythmic, Free, Legacy
  revdiv <0..8>  : 1/4, 1/1, 1/2, 1/8, 1/16, 1/4D, 1/8D, 1/4T, 1/8T
  rvb <0/1>   : Reverse Reverb
  spr <0/1>   : Spring Reverb
  spm <0-100> : Spring Mix
  spd <0-100> : Spring Decay
  spf <0-100> : Spring Damping
 [ACCIDENTAL WARP V1.3]
  wrp <0/1>   : Warp Enable/Bypass
  wsp <0-2.0> : Warp Speed Multiplier (1.0 = +1 Octave)
  wgr <10-400>: Warp Grain Window in ms
  wst <0-1.0> : Warp Stereo Phase Offset
  wfb <0-95>  : Warp Feedback %
  wmd <0-3>   : Warp Mode (0=2T-Herm, 1=1T-Herm, 2=1T-Raw, 3=2T-Raw)
  perf        : DSP Performance & Telemetry Stats
  identity    : Firmware commit/source/ELF identity and boot configuration
  audiohealth : One real PCM block and I2S write result (outside benchmark)
 [GLOBAL TRANSPORT CLOCK]
  tempo <bpm> : Set global BPM
  transport <play|pause|stop|reset|status> : Transport controls
  tap [status|reset] : Tap tempo input, query status, or reset estimator
  clock <source [internal|tap|midi]|status|reset> : MIDI Clock & Tempo Source controls

  load <preset> : clean, lofi, dub, broken, warp_octave, warp_cascade
